hooks.text: Pluto doesn't even orbit its own center.
Pluto orbits an empty point in open space.
Why does Pluto orbit an empty spot in space?

title: Why Pluto Orbits Empty Space
description: Pluto and its massive moon Charon don't follow normal planetary rules. Their shared center of gravity hovers completely outside Pluto in open space.

beats.text: Pluto had an odd recurring bulge every 6.4 days.

beats.text: That bulge was Charon, a moon roughly half Pluto's size.

beats.text: Because Charon holds one-eighth of Pluto's mass, gravity pulls both.

beats.text: The shared center of mass sits outside Pluto itself.
